title: Lifting at one stage on one supplied affine chart
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a ring functor and $c$ a limit cone of its opposite Spec diagram with affine vertex. Fix $i\le j$ and a scheme morphism $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}R_i$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Let $F_j,G_j$ be finitely presented quasi-coherent modules on $X_j=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R_i}\operatorname{Spec}R_j$ [pqf-def-coherent], and let $\varphi$ be a map of their tensor pullbacks to $X=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R_i}c.pt$. Supply an arbitrary open cover $U_j$ of $X_j$ and one index $a$ such that its chart $U_j.X(a)$ is affine. There exists $k\ge j$ such that the selected chart of the pulled-back cover on $X_k$ admits a map between the restrictions of the tensor pullbacks of $F_j,G_j$ whose further pullback equals the restriction of $\varphi$, transported by the canonical tensor composition isomorphism [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso] and restriction/tensor pullback comparison [def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison]. Only this one chart has a lift asserted. No finite cover, common stage for multiple charts or overlap equation is asserted. No Noetherianity or finiteness assumption on $f$ is imposed. No persistence at indices beyond k is asserted.

source.place: Tag 01ZR, first proof, affine case; Tag 05N7 (2); the finite-stage lifting part of lem-pc-rf-perfect-base-change, Noetherian approximation

proof.text: Restrict Fj and Gj to the supplied affine chart by ordinary module pullback. The proved source-library pullback instances preserve finite presentation and quasi-coherence. Conjugate the limit restriction of phi by the direct cover tensor comparison to give an ordinary chart map psi.

Apply affine_chart_ordinary_map_descent to those two chart modules and psi to obtain k, j <= k, an ordinary stage chart map s and its ordinary recovery equation. The cone naturality and baseChangeMap_comp establish the ambient triangle. Conjugate s by the stage cover comparison, giving an explicit r. Apply chart_tensor_pullback_lift_transport to the triangle and the recovery equation for s. This is the desired equation for r; construct the required existential witnesses.

proof_origin.note: Lean reduction separates ordinary affine Hom descent from finiteness-free canonical comparison transport. Unit route unchanged.

theorem finitePresentation_one_chart_map_lift_at_stage
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (Fj Gj : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Modules)
    (hF : Fj.IsFinitePresentation) (hFq : Fj.IsQuasicoherent)
    (hG : Gj.IsFinitePresentation) (hGq : Gj.IsQuasicoherent)
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
            (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).obj Fj ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
            (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).obj Gj)
    (Uj : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).OpenCover.{u})
    (a : Uj.I₀) (ha : IsAffine (Uj.X a)) :
    ∃ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k),
      let A := Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
            (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
            (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
            (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
              (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl))
      let B := Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
              (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
              (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op k)) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)).op))
      let q := baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
        (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
          (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl))
      let U : (pullback f (Spec.map
        (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))).OpenCover.{u} := Uj.pullback₁ q
      let e := Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso
            (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
              (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
              (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op k)) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)).op)))
            (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
              (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
              (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjk)))
                (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl)))
            (baseChangeMap f
              (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
              (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
              (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op)))
            (by
              rw [← baseChangeMap_comp]
              congr 1
              ext
              simpa using c.w (homOfLE hjk).op)
      let Q := modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData U.f
      let p := baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
        (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
        (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op k)) (c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)).op))
      let V := U.pullback₁ p
      ∃ r : (Q.obj (A.obj Fj)).obj a ⟶ (Q.obj (A.obj Gj)).obj a,
        let t := Scheme.Modules.openCoverTensorPullbackComparison p U a
        t.inv.app (A.obj Fj) ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (U.pullbackHom p a)).map r ≫ t.hom.app (A.obj Gj) =
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (V.f a)).map
          (e.inv.app Fj ≫ φ ≫ e.hom.app Gj)
